children.value: iti nirṇīya tatayā dhiyā dhavalayā muniḥ
babhūva na haṭhādeva haṭhayogo hi duḥkhadaḥ
na bahirnāntare nādho nordhve nāśāsu tatra te
babhūva na haṭhādeva haṭhayogo hi duḥkhadaḥ
cetanā jīvacit tasyāṃ bhāvitaṃ yadamṛtaṃ tanmadhyagāḥ
salilaughā iva saro vṛkṣaṃ madhurasā iva
madhau vasante pallavodgamahetavo bhaumā rasāḥ vṛkṣamiva ceti paramopamā
atha padmāsanagataḥ kṛtvā dehe sthitiṃ dṛḍham
śvasanaṃ śreyase deśe praśastaḥ samayo yathā
tilebhya iva tailāni pṛthak cakre prayatnataḥ
sattvaguṇodbhāvanavyagrasya tadanurūpastejaḥpuñjabhramastasyābhūdityāha tallulāva sthalābjānāṃ vanaṃ bāla iva dvipaḥ
pūrva vṛṣṭaḥ paścāccharadi mūko nirgatajalaśca yo'mbudastatsadṛśasthitiḥ
tatra siddhāḥ surāḥ sādhyāḥ sthitā brahmaharādayaḥ
kṣaṇaṃ varṣasahasraṃ vā tatra labdhvā sthitiṃ manaḥ
tatpadaṃ sā gatiḥ śāntā tacchreyaḥ śāśvataṃ śivam
tatra viśrāntimāptasya bhūyo no bhādhate bhramaḥ
dṛśyaṃ na bahu manyante rājāno dīnatāmiva
vasanta iva mañjaryaḥ svarga eva bhavanti tāḥ
nābhyanandanna tatyāja tāṃ vibhūtiṃ sa dhīradhīḥ
tamupāsya yayuḥ siddhā dinaiḥ katipayaiḥ svayam

śaradi khamiva śāntaṃ vyātataṃ corjitaṃ ca
sphuṭamamalamacetastadvapuḥ saṃbabhāra
